text:
maria: heads up — console latency heatmap shows a weird tail on /generate-v2. p50 steady, but p95 and p99 jump for the last 30m. https://console.internal/redwood/latency?endpoint=/generate-v2 :thinking_face:
kevin: can you paste the endpoint breakdown? is it specific to a region or routing class?
maria: looks like it’s across two regions but concentrated on requests routed to the "fallback-pool" shard. attached screenshot (small).
sam: FYI we started a quota throttle change 45m ago for bursty tenants — could be correlated. throttles -> retries -> extra latency.
infra-bot: alert: /generate-v2 p99 crossed 1200ms at 1863032045. recent deploy: infra/routing v2.1 at 1863030000.
kevin: ok, two hypotheses: 1) fallback-pool has less warm KV cache so cold-cache tail; 2) quota-policy is triggering client retries that route to fallback.
lisa: ui note — the rollout UX currently rolls up latencies across routing paths, which hides fallback spikes. we should expose a per-routing-path column (routing_path tag).
maria: quick query I ran to confirm (from telemetry):
```
SELECT routing_path, quantile(50)(lat_ms) AS p50, quantile(95)(lat_ms) AS p95, quantile(99)(lat_ms) AS p99
FROM requests
WHERE endpoint = '/generate-v2' AND timestamp > now() - interval '60 minutes'
GROUP BY routing_path
```
kevin: nice. results?
maria: 
- primary-pool: p50=95ms p95=180ms p99=230ms
- fallback-pool: p50=210ms p95=1100ms p99=1800ms
sam: huge delta on fallback. also see 429 -> client retry spikes in the logs around the same timeframe: `tenant=acme retries=2 status=429`.
kevin: that matches the quota-change window. idea: change fallback policy so quota-triggered reroutes go to a warm standby instead of cold fallback. PR to change policy + add metric `routing_decision` to request trace.
lisa: and on Console: add a per-route filter and a compact badge showing "fallback %" for each endpoint. should be low-effort in the short term (toggle column).
maria: agreed. next steps:
- kevin: patch routing policy (change fallback target) — quick rollback safe path included.
- sam: revert/adjust quota throttle for bursty tenants if we see more errors.
- lisa: add routing_path column + small badge in the endpoint list by EOD.
- infra-bot: will post an update when p99 drops under 500ms for /generate-v2.
kevin: I’ll open the PR and link it here. ping me if you spot more endpoints with similar fallback skew. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — will follow up with a short blameless postmortem in #postmortems if this ends up affecting customers.
infra-bot: deploy started: infra/routing v2.1.1 -> target=fallback-policy-change at 1863032280.
kevin: after deploy, p99 dropped to ~340ms within two minutes. marking as mitigated for now. will keep onwatch. :rocket:
